A '''2-1B surgical droid''' was a staff member of a nursery located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|droid]] was attending to the infants in the nursery when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vianna D'Pow]] infiltrated the nursery, looking for a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] infant. D'Pow depowered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with an electrical device in order to avoid detection. Later, when all of the infants were awoken by a fight right outside the nursery, their combined call on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] threw numerous objects, including the droid, across the room.
